label: SpbK system
definition: An abortive infection system in which an organism possesses a SpbK-family locus represented by the DefenseFinder SpbK__SpbK profile and exemplified by the ICEBs1 spbK gene whose SPß-YonE-dependent activity inhibits SPß production and kills infected cells.
observations: SpbK branch under abortive infection system; distinct from individual spbK genes, SpbK proteins, ICEBs1 elements, SPß YonE triggers, bacteriophage SPß, the DefenseFinder SpbK__SpbK HMM profile, source database rows naming one SpbK locus, unresolved SpbK-YonE coupling, TIR-domain effector chemistry, and generic abortive infection systems.
